result_text:
The remainder team now only collects active unmatched contributors. The change is one condition in `LandscapeAnalysisResults.getAllTeams()`, in `codeanalyzer/src/main/java/nl/obren/sokrates/sourcecode/landscape/analysis/LandscapeAnalysisResults.java`:

```java
if (!added[0] && !remainder.getMembers().contains(email) && contributor.getContributor().isActive()) {
```

- **Dormant unmatched contributors** are skipped and do not appear in "Undefined Team".
- **Blank latest-commit dates** count as active, because `DateUtils.isDateWithinRange` already returns true for blank input, so `isActive()` covers that case.
- **Configured teams** are untouched; the team-matching branch runs before the remainder check and keeps all members.

`mvn -q -o -pl codeanalyzer test -Dtest='*Landscape*,*Contributor*'` ran with no output and no failures. No existing test classes reference `LandscapeAnalysisResults` or `TeamsConfig`, so this change has no direct test coverage. I did not add a test. Nothing was committed.
